days.name: Sun 02/08
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (63%), wind 20 mph (gusts 43 mph), 0% precip
calendar_items: Dinner at friend's house — Philly Cheesesteaks
days.dinner_description: The cheesesteak was born in 1930 when Pat Olivieri, tired of his own hot dogs, grilled sliced beef with onions on an Italian roll at the corner of 9th and Passyunk in South Philly. A passing cabbie tried one, told Pat to forget the franks, and an American icon was born. Tonight you get the real thing at a friend's table — no cooking required.
days.dinner_notes: Pick up steak from RD. Sourdough bread is ready and resting for the week ahead.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: High protein from beef, moderate fat from cheese. Balanced by the social joy of eating with friends.
days.album_description: Recorded at Montrose Recording in Richmond, VA with engineer Adrian Olsen, Solar Music is Butcher Brown's genre-defying manifesto — jazz, funk, hip-hop, and soul colliding in a five-piece collective that calls their sound 'everything under the sun.'
days.album_sonic_description: Jazz-funk fusion, heavy drums, wah-wah guitar, horn arrangements, progressive soul
days.album_pairing_rationale: Cheesesteaks deserve swagger, and this Richmond funk collective brings it. Plus they're playing The Atlantis in DC on March 13.
days.activity_notes: Bundle up — 22°F with 43 mph gusts! Sourdough bread is ready for the week.
days.day_intro: Bundle up — it's 22°F with 43 mph gusts rattling the windows, a perfect excuse to head to a friend's house and let someone else do the cooking.

days.name: Mon 02/09
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (72%), wind 7 mph (gusts 12 mph), 1% precip
time_constraints: Use the raw chicken tonight before it goes bad
days.dinner: Herb-Roasted Whole Chicken with Root Vegetables & Pan Gravy
days.dinner_description: A whole chicken rubbed with herb butter, set atop a bed of carrots, parsnips, and potatoes, roasted until the skin crackles and the drippings pool into a simple pan gravy. Tear off hunks of Sunday's sourdough to sop up every last drop. This is the dinner Thomas Keller calls 'the benchmark of a cook.'
days.dinner_notes: Start the chicken at 5 PM for a 6:30 table. Save the carcass — tomorrow's broth starts tonight.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Excellent protein from chicken. Root vegetables provide fiber, vitamin A, and potassium. Well-rounded meal.
days.album: Ambrose Akinmusire – honey from a winter stone
days.album_description: Grammy-nominated for Best Alternative Jazz Album, Akinmusire's winter-titled record is atmospheric and emotionally searching — the trumpet floating over spare arrangements like breath visible in cold air.
days.album_sonic_description: Modern jazz trumpet, atmospheric textures, restrained rhythm section, spacious arrangements
days.album_pairing_rationale: A winter-titled jazz album for the week's coldest night. Trumpet warmth mirrors the thyme-scented air of a roasting kitchen.
days.activity: Make chicken broth from the carcass after dinner
days.activity_notes: Coldest night of the week — perfect for staying in. The house will smell amazing.
prep_notes: Take chicken out of fridge 1 hour before roasting
Prep root vegetables while chicken comes to room temp
days.day_intro: The coldest night of the week — 10°F low — and the house will fill with the scent of thyme, rosemary, and roasting bird. Stay in, stay warm.

days.name: Tue 02/10
time_constraints: Dinner after swim lessons — needs to be fast
days.dinner_description: Handmade egg-yolk pasta in the Emilian tradition — yolks only, no whites — yielding golden, silky noodles with an almost custard-like richness. Tossed in a proper Alfredo of butter, cream, and Parmigiano-Reggiano. Fifteen minutes from boiling water to table.
days.dinner_notes: Make dough in the morning, rest in fridge. Boil water before leaving for swim — cook the moment you walk in the door.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Good protein from eggs. Spinach adds iron and folate. Rich in calcium from Parmigiano. Consider a side salad for extra fiber.
days.album_description: Recorded at Sudestudio in Italy and winner of the Premio Loano for best traditional album, Onde blends Salento pizzica rhythms with post-rock guitars. Guest spots include Nigerien desert-blues guitarist Bombino.
days.album_sonic_description: Italian folk vocals, pizzica rhythms, accordion, frame drum, Mediterranean instrumentation
days.album_pairing_rationale: Italian pasta deserves real Italian music — not Sinatra, but Puglian frame drums and a voice that channels the Southern coast.
days.activity_notes: Warmest day of the week at 45°F — enjoy the relative thaw! Make pasta together in the morning.
prep_notes: Morning: Make babo pasta dough (spinach + egg yolks + flour)
Afternoon: Roll and cut pasta before swim
Set water to boil before leaving for swim
days.day_intro: The warmest day at 45°F — practically a thaw. Make pasta together in the morning, let the dough rest in the fridge, then roll and cut before swim lessons.

days.name: Wed 02/11
calendar_items: Elsie's afterschool science potions camp 3:45-4:45 PM
days.dinner: Warm Farro Salad with Roasted Beets, Goat Cheese & Walnuts
days.dinner_description: Warm farro — the ancient Tuscan grain — tossed with roasted golden and red beets, crumbled goat cheese, toasted walnuts, arugula, and dried cranberries, all dressed in a sherry-maple vinaigrette. Substantial, earthy, and ready in the time it takes to cook the grain.
days.dinner_notes: Roast beets during camp. Farro takes 25 minutes — start when she walks in. Assembly is fast.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Excellent fiber from farro and beets. Beets are rich in nitrates and folate. Goat cheese adds calcium. Walnuts provide omega-3s. One of the week's most nutritionally complete meals.
days.album_description: Recorded at Double Infinity studio in the Massachusetts mountains with Nick Hakim on piano, Bright Future is Grammy-nominated folk at its most intimate — fingerpicked guitar, whispered vocals, and the unhurried patience of a snow day.
days.album_sonic_description: Acoustic guitar, fingerpicking, intimate vocals, lo-fi warmth, folk minimalism
days.album_pairing_rationale: An earthy grain salad on a quiet Wednesday calls for music that's equally unhurried — Lenker's gentle folk mirrors the meal's honest simplicity.
days.activity_notes: Pickup at 4:45 PM. Ask about potions experiments at dinner!
prep_notes: Roast beets during science camp (45 min at 400°F)
Toast walnuts in a dry pan
Cook farro when Elsie gets home
days.day_intro: Midweek calm. Elsie's at Science Potions Camp until 4:45 — roast the beets while she's gone, then assemble dinner together when she's home.

days.name: Thu 02/12
days.calendar: Work Potluck (lunch) — Dan's Taco Bar. Elsie's Dance Camp 3:45-4:45 PM
calendar_items: Work Potluck for lunch — Dan making taco bar
Elsie's dance after school camp 3:45-4:45 PM
time_constraints: Big lunch at potluck — lighter dinner preferred
Prep taco bar ingredients in the morning
days.dinner_description: Shakshuka — eggs poached in a spiced tomato-pepper sauce fragrant with cumin, paprika, and harissa. The dish traces to the Maghreb, where its Arabic name simply means 'a mixture.' Thick slices of Sunday's sourdough, rubbed with za'atar and olive oil, are the only utensil you need.
days.dinner_notes: Light dinner after heavy potluck. One skillet, minimal cleanup. Uses Sunday's sourdough.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: High protein from eggs. Lycopene from tomatoes. Vegetarian. Light and balanced after a heavy potluck lunch.
days.album: Anouar Brahem – The Astounding Eyes of Rita
days.album_description: Released on ECM, Brahem's oud quartet merges Arabic maqam traditions with jazz and chamber music. Klaus Gesing's bass clarinet weaves around the oud like smoke — hypnotic, meditative, impossible to rush.
days.album_sonic_description: Oud, piano, accordion, double bass — sparse and spacious chamber jazz with Middle Eastern modalities
days.album_pairing_rationale: North African comfort food deserves music from the same world. Brahem's Tunisian oud creates the meditative atmosphere shakshuka was made for.
days.activity: Work potluck (lunch) + Elsie's dance camp (3:45-4:45 PM)
days.activity_notes: Prep taco bar in the morning (sour cream, guac, taco shells, beef, shredded lettuce). Light dinner after heavy lunch.
prep_notes: Morning: Brown taco beef, prep guac, shred lettuce, pack taco shells + sour cream for potluck
Evening: Shakshuka is a 30-minute one-pan meal — start after Elsie pickup
days.day_intro: A lighter evening after the potluck lunch. Dance camp pickup at 4:45, then a one-skillet dinner that practically cooks itself.

days.name: Fri 02/13
days.calendar: Elsie YAT 4:30-6:00 PM. Laura Book Club (evening).
time_constraints: Elsie pickup from YAT at 6:00 PM
Laura at book club — Dan and Elsie cooking together
days.dinner: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes with Maple Breakfast Sausage
days.dinner_description: Fluffy ricotta pancakes brightened with lemon zest and juice, served with real maple syrup and pan-seared breakfast sausage. The ricotta pancake tradition traces to Sephardic Jews in medieval Southern Italy — tonight it's Elsie's choice, and she's flipping.
days.dinner_notes: Elsie's pick! Let her measure and flip. Pack bags for Albuquerque before bed — 4:30 AM comes fast.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Protein from ricotta, eggs, and sausage. Vitamin C from lemon. A treat meal — balance with fruit on the side.
days.album_description: Recorded live to tape at Killion Sound in North Hollywood by producer Sergio Rios, Silver is Brooklyn disco-soul with a conscience — Motown harmonies, Chic-inspired grooves, and lyrics tackling everything from bodily autonomy to feminist art.
days.album_sonic_description: Three-part harmonies, disco-funk bass, vintage keys, Motown-inspired arrangements with indie sensibility
days.album_pairing_rationale: Breakfast-for-dinner is a celebration, and Say She She's disco-funk will have Elsie dancing at the stove. They're at 9:30 Club on Feb 17.
days.activity: YAT 4:30-6:00 PM. Dad + Elsie cooking night. Laura at book club.
days.activity_notes: Pack for tomorrow's 4:30 AM flight to Albuquerque! Pre-Valentine's Day vibes.
prep_notes: Set out pancake ingredients before YAT pickup
Pre-measure dry ingredients so Elsie can help assemble
days.day_intro: Friday fun night — Laura's at book club, so it's Dad and Elsie in the kitchen. Pack for tomorrow's 4:30 AM flight while the pancakes cool.

days.name: Sat 02/14
days.weather_detail: Sunny (91%), wind 9 mph (gusts 25 mph), 30% precip, possible light snow
days.calendar: Flight 4:30 AM to Albuquerque. YAT 9:00 AM-12:00 PM (tentative). Valentine's Day!
time_constraints: Travel day — all meals eaten out
days.dinner_description: New Mexico stacked enchiladas smothered Christmas style — half red chile (deep, smoky, earthy) and half green chile (bright, tangy, sharp). The name doesn't come from the holiday; it comes from a server's suggestion to a customer who couldn't choose. Order with a side of sopaipillas and carne adovada.
days.dinner_notes: Valentine's dinner in Albuquerque! Try Cocina Azul or Sadie's. Don't skip the sopaipillas.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: Restaurant meal — enjoy without overthinking. The chile peppers are loaded with vitamin C and capsaicin.
days.album_description: Manzanares is a northern New Mexico native from a sheep-ranching family whose bilingual folk won Album of the Year at the New Mexico Music Awards. Her songs are sonic postcards from the Land of Enchantment — listen on the plane.
days.album_sonic_description: Acoustic guitar, bilingual vocals (English/Spanish), folk arrangements, New Mexico folk traditions
days.album_pairing_rationale: Flying to New Mexico? Start the experience at 30,000 feet with music from an Albuquerque native whose bilingual folk captures the exact landscape below.
days.activity: Travel to Albuquerque! Valentine's Day dinner.
days.activity_notes: 4:30 AM flight. YAT at 9 AM may be tentative. Valentine's Day — love in the high desert!
prep_notes: Bags should be packed Friday night
Download Lara Manzanares album for the plane
days.day_intro: Valentine's Day in the high desert. You woke at 3:30 AM, flew west, and landed in a city where the question isn't 'how are you?' — it's 'red or green?'

appetizers.name: Warm Baked Ricotta with Lemon & Herbs
appetizers.description: Whole-milk ricotta baked until golden and slightly puffed, finished with lemon zest, fresh herbs, cracked pepper, and good olive oil. Served with sourdough crostini.

appetizers.name: Whipped Feta Dip with Roasted Red Peppers & Za'atar
appetizers.description: Feta whipped with cream cheese, lemon, and garlic until fluffy, topped with roasted red peppers, olive oil, and za'atar. Served with warm pita.

salads.name: Winter Citrus & Radicchio Salad
salads.description: Composed arrangement of blood orange and cara cara segments, shaved radicchio, burrata, pistachios, and Castelvetrano olives.
salads.dressing: Blood orange vinaigrette: fresh blood orange juice, champagne vinegar, Dijon mustard, EVOO, minced shallot, flaky salt, honey
salads.flavor_rationale: Bitter radicchio tamed by sweet citrus and creamy burrata. The vinaigrette brightens every bite. Follows the Italian principle of balancing amaro with dolce and grasso.

salads.name: Shaved Brussels Sprout Slaw with Pecorino & Hazelnuts
salads.description: Thinly shaved Brussels sprouts tossed with shaved Pecorino Romano, toasted hazelnuts, and a bright lemon-anchovy dressing.
salads.dressing: Lemon-anchovy dressing: fresh lemon juice, anchovy paste, Dijon mustard, EVOO, garlic, salt, pepper
salads.flavor_rationale: Umami from anchovy and Pecorino meets the mild bitterness of raw Brussels sprouts. Lemon brightens, hazelnuts add toasty warmth.

salads.name: Simple Arugula & Parmesan with Lemon Vinaigrette
salads.description: Peppery arugula with shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano, lemon, and the best olive oil you have. The 3-minute side salad that elevates any dinner.
salads.dressing: Fresh lemon juice, EVOO, Maldon salt, cracked black pepper
salads.flavor_rationale: Arugula's pepperiness softened by the nuttiness of Parmigiano and fruity acidity of lemon. Every ingredient pulls its weight.

beverages.name: Côtes du Rhône
beverages.description: Medium-bodied Grenache-Syrah-Mourvèdre blend with red fruit, herbs, and gentle spice. Versatile enough for chicken, pasta, or cheesesteaks. Look for Guigal or Chapoutier ($12-16).
beverages.why: An everyday red that pairs with the widest range of this week's dinners.

beverages.name: Sparkling Water with Blood Orange & Rosemary
beverages.description: Sparkling mineral water with muddled blood orange, rosemary sprig, and lime squeeze. Refreshing, zero-proof, and ties into the winter citrus theme.
beverages.why: Kid-friendly and festive without alcohol. Ties into the winter citrus salad theme.

beverages.name: Mexican Hot Chocolate
beverages.description: Rich hot cocoa with cinnamon, a pinch of cayenne, vanilla, topped with whipped cream or marshmallows. Warming for cold February nights.
beverages.why: Ties into New Mexico travel theme. Kid-approved. Perfect for 20°F evenings.

Protein: whole chicken (4 lbs — use from fridge)

prep_ahead: Saturday (Feb 7): Thaw chicken if frozen. Bake sourdough bread.
Sunday: Pick up steak from RD. Sourdough ready for the week.
Monday morning: Take chicken out 1 hour before roasting.
Monday evening: After dinner, start chicken broth with carcass.
Tuesday morning: Make babo pasta dough (spinach + egg yolks + flour). Rest in fridge.
Tuesday afternoon: Roll and cut pasta before swim lessons.
Wednesday during science camp: Roast beets (45 min at 400°F).
Thursday morning: Prep taco bar for work potluck — brown beef, shred lettuce, pack shells + sour cream + guac.
Friday afternoon: Pre-measure pancake dry ingredients. Set out ricotta and lemons.
Friday evening: PACK FOR ALBUQUERQUE. Bags by the door. TSA docs ready.
Friday evening: Download Lara Manzanares album for the plane.
notes: Sourdough bread (Sunday) is used for: Monday's chicken dinner, Thursday's shakshuka toast, and appetizer crostini
Chicken carcass (Monday) becomes broth — freeze for future soups
Thursday's potluck taco bar ingredients: ground beef, taco shells, sour cream, guac, shredded lettuce
Saturday 4:30 AM flight to Albuquerque — pack Friday night!
Valentine's Day dinner in Albuquerque — make reservations at Cocina Azul or Sadie's
YAT on Saturday (9 AM-12 PM) is tentative — may conflict with travel

Sourdough is the quiet thread stitching this week together: baked Sunday, torn alongside Monday's roast chicken, rubbed with za'atar for Thursday's shakshuka, and sliced into crostini for appetizers. One loaf, four acts.

The music mirrors the journey — Richmond funk and winter jazz give way to Puglian folk and Tunisian oud, before disco-funk and New Mexican balladry carry the family to Albuquerque. Every album was chosen to meet the meal where it lives.
highlight: From sourdough and roast chicken on the coldest night to Christmas enchiladas in the high desert — a week that warms from the inside out.
daily_plan_subtitle: From American to New Mexican, with Butcher Brown on the stereo
